evidence.detail: select name='{{prefix}}archetype_id'; when prefix is empty all queue selects get the same name 'archetype_id'
Loop over self.queue never sets d['prefix'], so all archetypedropdowns render with name='archetype_id'
Server reads archetype_ids = request.form.getlist('archetype_id') positionally; fails when browser restores shifted values on tab-reopen

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/views/edit_archetypes.py, add d['prefix'] = f'{d.id}_' inside the queue loop so each dropdown renders as name='12345_archetype_id'. In decksite/controllers/admin.py, replace the getlist('archetype_id') approach with reading form.get(f'{deck_id}_archetype_id') for each deck_id in the submitted deck_id list. ~15 lines total across two files.
triage.notes: The other archetypedropdown usages on the same page (Move, Rename, Update Description) are not inside the queue loop and will still have empty prefix, so they remain name='archetype_id' — no change needed for those code paths.
